subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Clear the air

options.text: To use aroma to sweeten the air
To deal openly with misunderstandings to get rid of them

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** meaning of the idiom** "Clear the air" is 3) **To deal openly with misunderstandings to get rid of them.
 
• The idiom** "Clear the air"** is **used **metaphorically to describe a situation where there are misunderstandings or tension between people.(संदेह दूर करना/ स्पष्टीकरण करना)
 
• **It refers** to the act of openly addressing those misunderstandings or resolving conflicts in order to improve the situation and create a more positive atmosphere.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *'To deal openly with misunderstanding to get rid of them'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) **"To use aroma to sweeten the air" is not the correct meaning of the idiom. While it involves improving the air quality, it does not relate to resolving conflicts or misunderstandings between people.
 
• **Option 2) **"To switch off fans" is not the correct meaning of the idiom. It is a literal interpretation and does not capture the intended metaphorical sense of addressing misunderstandings.
 
• **Option 4)** "To reduce pollution" is not the correct meaning of the idiom. While it involves improving the air quality, it does not pertain to resolving conflicts or misunderstandings between people.
